paper.title: Little Red Dots: Rapidly Growing Black Holes Reddened by Extended Dusty Flows

result.summary: 本文针对 JWST 发现的“小红点”（LRD）的 V 形光谱能量分布（SED）提出一个从静止系紫外到红外的 SED 模型 [S1.p6]。模型假设一个具有典型 SED 的 AGN 入射辐射被嵌入在延展的尘埃介质中，其消光律类似猎户座星云或某些 AGN 环境 [S1.p6]。紫外-光学谱由尘埃衰减的 AGN 辐射描述，在 λ>4000 Å 呈红色光学连续谱，在 λ<3000 Å 通过灰消光曲线形成平坦紫外谱 [S5.p2]。红外部分由延展的尘埃和气体分布塑造，使较冷的尘埃温度主导辐射，从而将能量峰值从近红外移到中红外 [S5.p2]。该模型无需额外的恒星辐射或 AGN 散射光，并能产生与 JWST MIRI 观测一致的 LRD 红外 SED 平坦化 [S1.p6]。

research_question.text: 论文要解决的问题是理解 LRD 的 V 形光谱特征及其起源，以及其中 AGN 与星系的相对贡献 [S5.p1]。LRD 的独特 V 形光谱特征——静止系中红色光学连续谱与紫外过剩——挑战人们辨别星系和 AGN 的相对贡献 [abstract]。

evidence.quote: the characteristic v-shape spectral feature observed through JWST/NIRCam challenges us to understand the origin of these LRDs and the contribution from AGNs powered by accreting BHs.
Their unique v-shape spectral feature characterized by a red optical continuum and a UV excess in the rest frame challenges us to discern the relative contributions of the galaxy and AGN.

method.text: 论文提出一个从静止系紫外到红外波段的 LRD 的 SED 模型 [S1.p6]。模型假设来自 AGN 的入射辐射被嵌入在延展的尘埃介质中，其消光律类似猎户座星云或某些 AGN 环境 [S1.p6]。紫外-光学谱由尘埃衰减的 AGN 辐射描述，包含红色光学连续谱和通过灰消光建立的紫外过剩，无需额外的恒星辐射或 AGN 散射光 [S1.p6]。红外部分由延展的尘埃和气体分布塑造，使较冷的尘埃温度主导辐射，从而将能量峰值从近红外移到中红外 [S1.p6]。

evidence.quote: In this paper, we study a SED model for LRDs from rest-frame UV to infrared bands.

We hypothesize that the incident radiation from an AGN, characterized by a typical SED, is embedded in an extended dusty medium with an extinction law similar to those seen in dense regions such as Orion Nebula or certain AGN environments.
The UV-optical spectrum is described by dust-attenuated AGN emission, composed of a red optical continuum and a UV excess established through gray extinction.
There is no need for additional stellar emission or AGN scattered light.

In the infrared, the SED is shaped by an extended dust and gas distribution, which allows relatively cool dust temperatures to dominate the radiation, thereby shifting the energy peak from near- to mid-infrared bands.

experiments.text: 模型假设视觉消光 A_V=3 mag，并将衰减通量在 λ=4000 Å 处归一化 [S2.p5]。作为参照，论文叠加了在 z~5.5 和 z=7.5 处堆叠 LRD 样本得到的光度 SED 数据 [S2.p5]。论文还将从 AGN 复合谱导出的消光律应用于一个由 JWST NIRSpec 在 z=4.5321 确认的 LRD（ID: J0647-1045）[S2.p6]。

evidence.quote: For all the cases, we assume a visual extinction $A_{\mathrm{V}}=3$ mag and normalize the attenuated fluxes at $\lambda=4000~{\rm\AA}$.
As reference, we overlay photometric SED data obtained from stacking LRD samples at $z\sim 5.5$ (orange) and $z=7.5$ (blue).
The application of the extinction law derived from AGN composite spectra was tested on a LRD (ID: J0647-1045) identified at $z=4.5321$ by JWST NIRSpec.

findings.text: 模型能够再现 λ≳3000-4000 Å 处斜率 β_opt≳0 的红色连续谱成分 [S2.p5]。采用猎户座星云和 AGN 复合谱的消光律的模型将 SED 压平至紫外斜率 β_UV~-2，而其他模型导致强烈衰减的通量，无法维持紫外过剩 [S2.p5]。在两种模型中，入射紫外通量被降低两个数量级，即入射通量的 1% [S2.p5]。论文进一步表明，这种灰消光曲线可以解释 LRD 的特征 V 形 SED，而无需考虑宿主星系或散射 AGN 光等多成分 [S2.p6]。该模型不同于典型的 AGN 热环模型，能够产生与 JWST MIRI 的 LRD 观测一致的红外 SED 平坦化 [S1.p6]。

evidence.quote: The attenuated flux density reproduces a red continuum component at $\lambda\gtrsim 3000-4000~{\rm\AA}$ with a slope of $\beta_{\rm opt}\gtrsim 0$
Models with extinction laws observed in the Orion Nebula and AGN composite spectra flatten the SED with a UV slope of $\beta_{\rm UV}\sim-2$.
In contrast, other models result in strongly attenuated flux that fails to maintain a UV excess.
In the two models, the incident UV flux is reduced by two orders of magnitude, i.e., $1\%$ of the incident flux.

Our findings in this work further demonstrate that such gray extinction curves can explain the characteristic v-shaped SEDs of LRDs, as evidenced by accumulated large samples, without considering multiple components such as host galaxies or scattered AGN light.
This model can produce an infrared SED flattening that is consistent with LRD observations through JWST MIRI.

limitations.text: 论文指出，LRD 为何在 z>4 以统一的 A_V=3 mag 消光水平出现这一问题目前没有明确答案，只给出了一些推测 [S4.SS4.p1]。关于尘埃散射导致 AGN 变异性减弱的场景，论文表示更详细的定量分析将在未来工作中探索 [S4.SS3.p2]。论文强调其方法并不排除 LRD 中存在宿主星系 [S4.SS2.p5]。

evidence.quote: There is no clear answer to this question at this time, but some speculations are given below.
A more detailed quantitative analysis of this scenario will be explored in future work.
Here, we emphasize that our approach does not rule out the existence of host galaxies in LRDs
